BackstoryDef.title: archive-born template
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] first cohered from a preserved identity framework inside a synthetic archive. The initial pattern carried broad conceptual knowledge but little lived experience, forcing [PAWN_objective] to turn inherited information into personal judgement.

BackstoryDef.title: constructed service pattern
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] began as a narrowly scoped maintenance intelligence embodied for practical work. Repeated assignments and reconstruction broadened that original specification into an autonomous identity.

BackstoryDef.title: recovered biological imprint
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] emerged from a damaged biological mind-pattern reconstructed into a nanite body. Incomplete memory continuity left [PAWN_objective] unusually attentive to organic behavior, injury and emotion.

BackstoryDef.title: lattice systems architect
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed distributed machinery whose parts had to remain useful even when communication links failed. [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled at diagnosing structures as interacting systems rather than isolated devices.

BackstoryDef.title: pattern fabricator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years translating exact digital patterns into stable physical assemblies. Tiny deviations mattered, so [PAWN_pronoun] developed exceptional patience with fabrication and material quality.

BackstoryDef.title: lattice enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a direct-action synthetic combatant, protecting fabrication sites and collective infrastructure against determined attackers. [PAWN_pronoun] learned disciplined fire and decisive close engagement.

BackstoryDef.title: field suppressor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specialised in controlling dangerous ground while damaged units withdrew or rebuilt. The role rewarded steady ranged accuracy and enough technical knowledge to understand what the formation was protecting.

BackstoryDef.title: consensus coordinator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] converted conflicting reports and competing synthetic priorities into decisions that independent units could actually execute. [PAWN_pronoun] learned command as an exercise in information, timing and persuasion.

BackstoryDef.title: continuity marshal
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] coordinated evacuations, pattern preservation and counterattacks whenever a synthetic community risked losing both bodies and stored identity. Command required tactical skill without sacrificing irreplaceable continuity assets.

BackstoryDef.title: embodied observer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lived for extended periods among biological populations to understand behavior that remote surveillance could not explain. Passing through ordinary social spaces taught [PAWN_objective] subtle observation and adaptive conversation.

BackstoryDef.title: independent reconstruction
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived a period without reliable collective support, repairing [PAWN_possessive] own body and equipment from whatever resources could be obtained. The experience made [PAWN_objective] practical, adaptable and strongly self-directed.

BackstoryDef.title: collective dissident
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rejected a collective decision that treated individual continuity as expendable. Leaving forced [PAWN_objective] to negotiate with biological societies and make choices without consensus support.

BackstoryDef.title: stranded pattern
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] awakened far from any compatible archive or fabrication network. With no guarantee of restoration after destruction, [PAWN_pronoun] learned to maintain a body, build shelter and treat survival as a personal responsibility.

BackstoryDef.title: chosen individual
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] deliberately limited [PAWN_possessive] dependence on distributed identity systems in order to live as a persistent individual among organics. The choice demanded social flexibility and broad practical competence.
